name: Memory Cleaner
description: Periodically forces full GC + LOH compaction + working-set trim to mitigate Emby long-running memory bloat.
overview: Lightweight standalone plugin. Compatible with StrmAssistant. Configurable interval (1-120 min, default 30). Status panel + auto-update task included.

versions.changelog: Added Cleanup Now button. Added Skip When Playing option (default ON) to avoid GC stutter during playback.
Added auto-update scheduled task. Checks manifest.json daily and replaces DLL when newer version found.
Default interval changed to 30 minutes. Added runtime status panel.
